description: This Java source file defines a Spring Boot REST controller named UserController, which handles HTTP requests related to user account management such as registration, deletion, email and password updates. It leverages various services for user operations, email notifications, and security.

classes.name: UserController
classes.description: A REST controller managing user account endpoints such as registration, deletion, and updates. Uses Spring Boot annotations for mapping HTTP requests to methods.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Retrieves a user by their ID. Throws 404 if not found.

methods.name: emailExists
methods.description: Checks if an email is registered, returns 404 if not.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Handles user registration, sends confirmation email, handles exceptions for duplicate email or validation errors.

methods.name: deleteCurrentUser
methods.description: Deletes the current authenticated user after verifying password, sends account deletion email.

methods.name: updateEmail
methods.description: Updates the email address of the current user after verifying current password.

methods.name: updatePassword
methods.description: Updates the password of the current user after verifying current password, sends notification email.
